makehuman_cc0.description: MakeHuman CC0 base mesh used as canonical topology seed

notes.integrity: source_revision and artifact_sha256 are separate fields. artifact_sha256 is populated only from actual downloaded bytes and is never substituted with a git SHA or package version.
notes.triposr_usage: Commercial profile requires the pinned TripoSR source commit.
notes.anime_face_detector_usage: Package version is pinned exactly in pyproject.toml.
notes.vrm_export: VRM 1.0 is emitted by the pure-Python pygltflib path; Blender/VRM Add-on is not a runtime dependency.
